description: Wellness / yoga / fitness / lifestyle campaign — warm amber tropical, tropical paradise cinematic, or high-key cyan beach. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: warm_amber_tropical = warm honey grade with golden haze. hanalei_cinematic = soft golden mist + infinity pool reflection. high_key_cyan_beach = bright daylit cyan ocean.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_wellness
title: Apply Wellness
